title: Route-render smoke and index context-contract tests
goal: Add broad GET route-render smoke coverage and a focused GET / context-contract test, so future UI / template work (UI-3.1 LineItemGrid, the post-UX-cleanup token consolidation, anything else) cannot ship a TemplateResponse regression of the same shape as the 56H-1 NameError bug.

why_56h1_was_missed.root_cause: 55G (PR #475) referenced a bare name 'validation_errors' inside a dict-literal value. Python does not bind dict-literal keys to names in the enclosing scope, so the bare reference raised NameError at runtime.
why_56h1_was_missed.test_gap: 55G / 55F / 55E tests import the helper functions in isolation; they do not render the full index route via FastAPI TestClient. CI runs Phase 51F + 51M-1 + revenue + opex + SHL waterfall tests, not the index route's TemplateResponse call. Parity Guardrails check structural invariants only.

routes_skipped.reason: requires a real scenario_id; the smoke test would need to seed a scenario fixture. Future: add a real seed-scenario fixture and a parametrized test.
requires a real run_id; the smoke test would need to seed a run. Future: add a real seed-run fixture and a parametrized test.
returns a streaming XLSX response; status is checked but content is not asserted (asserting XLSX format / structure is the job of the run tests).

recommendation: UI-3.1 can start conditionally. The 57pre smoke suite is in place. UI-3.1 work must (1) include the smoke suite in its test list, (2) add any new GET endpoint(s) to the parametrized GET_ROUTES table, (3) add any new context key on GET / to the TestIndexContextContract class, and (4) keep the 56H-1 regression pin passing. If the 57pre smoke suite fails on the UI-3.1 branch, the PR is rejected at the smoke-test step before it reaches the post-merge visual QA pass.
do_not_start: UI-3.1 (until this PR is merged and the smoke suite is in the UI-3.1 test list)
